_comment: JSON has no comment syntax, so the rationale lives in this key. tsc ignores unknown top-level keys.

exactOptionalPropertyTypes: false — @irp/client ships packages/client/src as raw, un-emitted TypeScript (see next.config.ts's transpilePackages comment), so importing it here pulls that generated source into THIS program under THIS project's compiler options. skipLibCheck (inherited from tsconfig.base.json) only exempts .d.ts files; these are .ts, so they are fully re-typechecked. @hey-api/client-fetch's generated runtime assigns `undefined` to optional properties explicitly, exactly the pattern packages/client/tsconfig.json already relaxes this same setting for, for the same generated code, under its own standalone typecheck. Without repeating the relaxation here, `pnpm --filter @irp/web typecheck` fails on packages/client/src files this project does not own and cannot edit.
